verbatim: 同意仅修订COUNTRY01这五个B06的结构接受定义，其他门槛保持不变。继续补齐账户来源和其余2544缺口，独审通过后正常合并main；不导入生产数据、不改生产权限、不启动World或Clock。
structuralAcceptance: Independently reviewed and exactly source-admitted typed financial-account binding records/register references; do not require an additional claim-free native CASH asset for each of these five entities. Preserve existing Core account types, legal roles and reciprocal claim sides.
representationChange: Single account value to versioned typed binding/register reference for these five IDs only; interface change requires independent review before use.
unchangedRequirements: Immutable genuine source-record identity, version, full-byte hash and exact row/pointer
Source issuance/custody/admission authority appropriate to account type
Exact record-set adoption evidence, not this definition receipt
Existing lawful inactive-opening World/genesis/head/asOf/valueDate and admitted currency binding
Original stable IDs, ACCOUNT unit, 350 B06 denominator, 2544 total and historical pins
Other 345 B06 IDs retain the prior acceptance definition
B07 actual native funds, complete restrictions/obligations, spendability and legitimate settlement route remain independent
Current server-side authorization, independent review, applicable checks and normal head-matched merge
notGranted: Adoption or issuance of account aliases/source records/record sets
Balances, funding, loan, grant, gold, FX, equity plug or new B/R/H/D
Inactive opening/time anchor creation or adoption
CB liabilities as a funded payer asset or duplicate cash
Automatic closure of any original ID
New Core account class, second financial engine or closure truth
